From:

Date:
17 July
Subject:
Xiao-Ming Hu's availability
Dear Ms. Landry:
I am very relieved that we were able to schedule filming of the third season of Best Son
for this September and October and that Xiao-Ming Hu will be available then to reprise
his role of Guo Tzeng.
I am writing to enquire whether Mr. Hu is available to film the outdoor winter scenes in
late December in Churchill, Manitoba. Please let me know as soon as possible, as filming
those scenes any sooner might require us to find another location. The shooting of the
winter scenes will take about two weeks and will be the last ones scheduled.
Sincerely,
Lexi Cotton
Production Manager, Fern Tree Productions
